classification_basis: accepted target-079 operational-v1 obligations replay unchanged; this package adds trusted-free adapter, insert_tail, and CopyOnDrop refinement

insert_tail_correspondence.proof_rule: field-complete well-founded induction on sift - begin, followed by entry-point lifting
valid_domains: non-panicked, non-aborted; 0 <= begin <= sift; gap == sift + 1; gap < sequence_len

source_order: derive every callback frame from accepted adapter_transition
perform the initial adapter call before creating an insertion gap
move sift into the current gap only after a normal Less result
advance the guard destination from gap to sift
commit callback state before ordinary panic or abort propagation
restore the active gap on normal return and ordinary panic
bypass CopyOnDrop restoration after double-panic abort

adapter-operands.insensitivity_reason: the proof obligations consume adapter_transition and target_adapter_is_less through their own definitions, so these two definition-consistent mutations are rejected by AST correspondence rather than by the Verus lemmas
